{"output": "def transform(grid):
    # The non-background marks on separator rows are paired left-to-right.
    # A pair encodes a cell only when both marks agree on both bounding rows.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
         if sum(v != bg for v in row) >= 2]
    cols = sorted({c for r in h for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != bg})
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(h, h[1:]):
        vals = []
        for i in range(0, len(cols) - 1, 2):
            x, y = cols[i], cols[i + 1]
            v = grid[a][x]
            vals.append(v if v == grid[a][y] == grid[b][x] == grid[b][y] else bg)
        # Empty columns in the source encode background between paired cells.
        if len(vals) > 1:
            vals = vals[:1] + [bg] + vals[1:]
        out.append(vals)
    return out", "exit_code": 0, "error": null}
